capabilities: Automate TaskNotes tasks with Markdown-defined trigger-and-step pipelines
Start and stop time tracking and clean up scheduled dates from status changes
Roll over overdue tasks and escalate priority as due dates approach
Connect cross-application contract events and actions via mdbase
Edit, dry-run, and enable workflows in a Bases-backed workflow view
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Legacy 0.1.x workflow files run through a compatibility reader, and the migration command creates backups before rewriting frontmatter. Interoperability requires enabling Allow local application interoperability in mdbase settings; host grants are default-deny.
intentEvidence: an optional companion plugin for TaskNotes
problem: TaskNotes has no built-in automation, so recurring task housekeeping such as time tracking, date rollovers, and priority escalation must be done by hand.

relations.evidence: required for cross-application contract events and contract actions

summary: Markdown-defined workflow automation companion for TaskNotes that runs trigger-and-step pipelines on task status, dates, and cross-application events.
